draft_en.subject: The 2 + 2 + 8 unit you asked about - unmanaged exists exactly, managed is 2 SFP + 8
draft_en.body:
Hi Byron,

Over the past months you had a steady stream of product mails from us - most recently "16 Port Industrial PoE Switch" on 17 September 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

You bought samples from us before and asked about a 2 x SFP + 2 x Gigabit uplink + 8 x PoE unit. Exactly that layout exists unmanaged: 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x Gigabit + 2 x SFP - model STC-228GP - $35.9 USD EXW with the INTERCOAX label (MOQ 1, 15-day validity). The managed version is 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP, L2+ on a Marvell platform - STC-28DGGPM - $87.4 - two uplinks, not four, said up front. CE/RoHS; KC stays on your side.

One question: which one matches the EoC kits you ship - the unmanaged 2 + 2 + 8, or managed?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
